title: ROSE: Risk-Aware Orthogonal Subspace Navigation for Lifelong Knowledge Editing in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.09770v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) require continuous factual updates to stay current, yet lifelong knowledge editing remains a daunting challenge. The primary obstacle is the severe Locality Erosion and Catastrophic Forgetting, where sequential edits inevitably interfere with pre-trained capabilities and prior updates. In this paper, we propose \textbf{ROSE}, a \textbf{R}isk-aware \textbf{O}rthogonal \textbf{S}ubspace navigation framework for lifelong knowledge \textbf{E}diting. ROSE addresses forgetting by aiming to restrict parameter updates to the orthogonal complement of previously edited subspaces. Crucially, it introduces a risk-guided mechanism that utilizes a dynamically computed risk mask to safeguard specific factual parameter subspaces essential for model stability. During inference, ROSE employs a multi-granularity knowledge integration strategy, featuring prototype-anchored semantic gating and perturbation-driven subs

translated_title: ROSE：面向多模态大语言模型终身知识编辑的风险感知正交子空间导航框架
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）需要持续的事实性更新以保持信息时效性，然而终身知识编辑仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。其主要障碍在于严重的局部性侵蚀和灾难性遗忘问题，即连续的编辑不可避免地会干扰预训练能力以及先前的更新。在本文中，我们提出了ROSE，一个面向终身知识编辑的风险感知正交子空间导航框架。ROSE通过将参数更新限制在先前已编辑子空间的正交补空间中，来应对遗忘问题。至关重要的是，它引入了一种风险引导机制，利用动态计算的风险掩码来保护对模型稳定性至关重要的特定事实参数子空间。在推理阶段，ROSE采用多粒度知识整合策略，其特点包括原型锚定的语义门控和扰动驱动的子空间（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出ROSE框架，通过将参数更新限制在已编辑子空间的正交补空间，并利用动态风险掩码保护关键事实参数子空间，有效缓解多模态大语言模型终身知识编辑中的局部性侵蚀与灾难性遗忘问题。
en_tdlr: ROSE is a risk-aware orthogonal subspace navigation framework that mitigates locality erosion and catastrophic forgetting in lifelong knowledge editing for multimodal large language models by restricting parameter updates to the orthogonal complement of previously edited subspaces and using dynamically computed risk masks to safeguard critical factual parameter subspaces.
